channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerryd Bayless | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerryd Bayless from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Jerryd Bayless, Derrick Rose
item.description:
“Duds made a heck of a pass. Bayless did the important thing by putting it in, but I think he sold the cut very well on Rose.”

Jason Kidd on Jerryd Bayless, Derrick Rose, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jerryd Bayless
item.description:
Peter Stringer:Brad Stevens on Jerryd Bayless' availability tonight:

“Jerryd felt pretty good, so we're going to bring him off the bench.”

Brad Stevens on Jerryd Bayless, Jan 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Jerryd Bayless
item.description:
But for the team to take the next step, Joerger believes the growth will need to come from the team’s younger role players.

“For us to grow from within Jerryd Bayless needs to have a nice season for us,”

Dave Joerger on Jerryd Bayless, Sep 20, 2013. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jose Manuel Calderon, Amir Johnson, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson, Andrea Bargnani
item.description:
Dwane Casey on the core players in Toronto:

“Andrea (Bargnani) is definitely a piece of the core that we have to utilize. He’s our star. DeMar Derozan is definitely an athletic part of our core, Jose Calderon, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson is in that group, and Amir Johnson. You’ve got the core now. The part you may have to add is a veteran piece, a veteran defender or whatever along with our draft pick is something that I’m sure Bryan and the staff are going to look at, but the core pieces are there to build on to use as building blocks. Those guys are the guys were gonna push, cajole, put an arm around, or whatever it takes to get to that next level.”

Dwane Casey on Jose Manuel Calderon, Amir Johnson, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson, Andrea Bargnani, Jun 22, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Jose Manuel Calderon on Jerryd Bayless
item.description:
“It’s like being with Jerryd (Bayless) now, (we’re) going to compete for minutes, that’s all.”

Jose Manuel Calderon on Jerryd Bayless, Nov 24, 2010. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Rich Cho on Jerryd Bayless
item.description:
It is the type of move Cho championed when he was hired in July: It helps the Blazers financially (owner Paul Allen saves $4.6 million), gives them future trade flexibility (the Blazers receive a $2.3 million trade exception) and gives them a potentially valuable asset (first-round pick) that…

“It's a good situation for Jerryd and a good situation for us,”

Rich Cho on Jerryd Bayless, Oct 24, 2010. Source: Oregonian.
